ModMetaData.name: RimTube
ModMetaData.author: ANLN666
ModMetaData.description:
Your colonists handle the chores. You handle the playlist.
Play public YouTube audio, videos and live streams, import local music, and organize everyday and combat playlists. Includes a mini player, floating video window, captions, four themes and automatic game-music playlists grouped by source. Traditional Chinese and English interfaces.
Windows x64 full bundle includes mpv, yt-dlp, Node.js, FFmpeg and ffprobe with automatic tool discovery. Player data is stored outside the installed mod. Includes an optional, player-triggered stable yt-dlp updater with verification and a bundled-version fallback. No scheduled updates. Windows public beta. All playback tools, licenses and provenance remain bundled. Complete corresponding tool sources and build recipes are available free, without login, from the fixed Release below. Tools/Sources/README.txt lists direct downloads and SHA-256 checksums. Sources are optional and are not downloaded on game startup. https://github.com/as5611198/RimTube-ThirdParty-Sources/releases/tag/tools-20261102-0.2.0
播放工具與授權仍隨包；完整對應工具原始碼與建置配方由上述固定 GitHub Release 免費提供，無須登入。模組內 Tools/Sources/README.txt 附直接下載與 SHA-256；玩遊戲不用下載來源材料。
本模組使用 Gemini 及 Codex（GPT）協助製作。 Created with assistance from Gemini and Codex (GPT).
